_doc: Committed expected values for the citation-drift gate. Per the PROTOCOL Gate standard: the frozen-run baseline pins the digest of every snapshot input file AND of the pointer table itself (a tampered or absent table is could-not-evaluate, never silent findings), and the self-test's expected exit codes and finding ids live here rather than in the script, so the expected values are independent of the recomputation.

frozen_run.note: the revision the committed verdict was measured against; a run over a different revision is a different measurement

pointer_table.note: frozen-run guard (R6 debt, arc3-loop1-round1): sha256 of pointer-table.json at the frozen run; any byte difference is pointer_table_tampered, an absent table is pointer_table_unreadable, an unpinned baseline is pointer_table_unpinned -- all exit 2
